properties.operator_1939_1945: U.S. Navy Seabees (CBD 1058); Wien Alaska Airlines (contract)
properties.runway_specs: Gravel river-bar & tundra runway along Colville River built spring 1945
properties.notes: Established early 1945 by Navy Seabee tractor trains from Point Barrow and airlift from Fairbanks/Bettles to drill Umiat Test Well #1 in Naval Petroleum Reserve No. 4.
properties.proof_summary: USGS Prof. Paper 301 & BLM NPR-4 History confirm spring 1945 Seabee camp & airfield construction supporting summer 1945 Umiat Test Well #1. Coordinates match PAUM.
